{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

dup_count = len(duplicates)
print(f'Duplicate patient_id counts: {dup_count}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}')

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
max_sample_seq_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq entries: {len(max_sample_seq_per_patient[max_sample_seq_per_patient > 1])}')"}
